name: When is the best time to install decorative trim during a renovation project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install decorative trim during a renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to install decorative trim is typically after major construction, drywall installation, and flooring preparation are complete, but before final painting. Installing trim after drywall ensures a smooth surface for attachment and minimizes damage to new trim during other construction phases. Having it in place before final painting allows for seamless caulking and touch-ups, resulting in a cleaner, more finished look. This sequence helps protect the new trim and integrate it smoothly into the overall project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install decorative trim after major construction, drywall, and flooring preparation, but before final painting, for best results.
